boone-county-public-library-main-library: Although the Main Library in Burlington and the Scheben Branch in Union already have wheelchairs , they are now available at the Hebron Branch, Florence Branch and Walton Branch.
Stop by the front desk to sign a waiver and borrow a wheelchair.
